prologue.title: Call of the Void
prologue.body1: Auguste Gaudin's letter reached you in Paris. A week before he wrote it, a German viol player named Erich Zann had joined the orchestra of the Auseil Theatre, grown steadily more withdrawn, and then disappeared altogether, leaving behind only a note begging the conductor's tolerance and forgiveness. Gaudin fears now for the rest of his musicians, and asks you to come to the theatre as soon as you are able.
prologue.isabel: It has been some time since you last played at the Auseil Theatre. Lately a dream has returned to you again and again: an impossible sheet of music, signed by one Erich Zann, that you play until your fingers wear through. Gaudin's letter names the very same man.

setup.gatherSets: Gather all cards from The Symphony of Erich Zann encounter set.
setup.setAsideEncounter: Set the Ears of the Void, Heard by Something and Young Nightingale encounter cards aside, out of play.
setup.setAsideStory: Set Auguste Gaudin (Maestro of Symphonies), Yin's Drumsticks, Page's Violin, La Fratta's Piano Key, Walker's Trumpet, all copies of Stuck in Your Head and The Piano aside, out of play.
setup.setAsideMusicians: Set the Arnold Walker, Isabel La Fratta, Nicole Page and Song Yin enemies aside, out of play.
setup.setAsideBeyondTheCurtain: Set the Beyond the Curtain story card aside, out of play.
setup.setAsideBackstage: Set each copy of the Backstage Room location aside, out of play, along with the Stage Hall location.
setup.placeLocations: Put the Entrance Hall, Main Lobby, Gallery and Auditorium locations into play. Each investigator begins play at the Entrance Hall.
setup.performerWeakness: Each {performer} investigator begins play with a copy of the set-aside Stuck in Your Head treachery in their hand. This card is added to their deck and does not count toward their deck size.
setup.shuffleRemainder: Shuffle the remainder of the encounter cards to build the encounter deck.

resolutions.investigatorDefeatBody: Darkness takes you, with pandemonium ahead and that night-baying orchestra behind. You stagger back, flail at nothing for what feels like an age, and come to in front of the theatre with the rain beating you awake.
resolutions.resolution1Body: You run: down the steps and the cobbles, across the dark bridge, out into the broader streets you know. There was no wind, the moon was out, and the lights of the city twinkled. Search as you might afterwards, you never find the Auseil Theatre again, nor the Rue d'Auseil, and no one you ask has heard of either. You are not wholly sorry — not for that, and not for the loss of the closely written sheets that alone could have explained the music of Erich Zann.

diesIrae.putIntoPlay: Put Dies Irae into play next to the agenda deck
